comparison.objective: Clamp locking pliers onto a tube past an over-center lock point; candidate adjusts and relocks a damper collar.
comparison.physical_skill: One-gripper high-force squeeze and release verification versus bimanual counterhold, hex-key loosening/tightening and fine collar rotation.
comparison.success_condition: Pliers remain latched on the target band after release versus the setscrew retains a tuned setting through impacts and a witness-torque test.
comparison.reason: Both test mechanical retention after release, but pliers test crossing an over-center latch while the candidate tests iterative damping calibration plus screw locking. Candidate lacks a numeric drift tolerance and witness-torque/locking-torque values.
